meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 完成NanoClaw v1到v2迁移的收尾：检查迁移报告，修复失败步骤，设置拥有者账户，迁移旧记忆，核对容器配置，处理v1自定义代码，最后验证并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”等关键词，且已运行过migrate-v2.sh脚本、存在handoff.json时触发。

say.note: 开始检查handoff.json并执行后续步骤。

say.text: 迁移卡住了，检查一下哪步失败了
say.note: 查看handoff报告中的失败项并修复。

say.text: 把v1的自定义代码移植到v2
say.note: 展示v1分支差异并选择处理方式。

howto.what_en: Completes the final steps of migrating NanoClaw v1 to v2: checks the migration report, fixes failed steps, seeds the owner account, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, handles custom v1 code, then verifies and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or "v1 migration", and only after `bash migrate-v2.sh` has completed (handoff.json exists).

say_en.text: Help me finish the v1 to v2 migration
say_en.note: Inspects handoff.json and runs the remaining steps.

say_en.text: The migration is stuck, check which step failed
say_en.note: Reviews failed steps in the handoff report and fixes them.

say_en.text: Port my custom v1 code to v2
say_en.note: Shows your v1 fork commits and lets you choose how to handle them.
